CustomField.description:
In Spain, the field gf_customer_status_type can have the following values:
0: The customer has at least one active contract with the entity. 1: The customer has no active contracts with the entity. 2: The customer has contracts that are all canceled, with at least one of them canceled within the last 18 months. 3: The customer has contracts that are all canceled, and all of them were canceled more than 18 months ago.
